Heading: Purpose
Body: To establish standardized deployment readiness reporting for all COMSUBLANT units. This message supersedes COMSUBLANT 061/26 and provides updated timelines, a reporting template, and validation procedures.

Heading: Background
Body: Recent assessments identified inconsistent readiness reporting across squadrons. The updated procedure improves data accuracy and aligns reporting with the force readiness tracking cycle.

Heading: Action
Body: Commanding Officers shall submit the enclosed reporting template NLT 07 NOV 2026 via prescribed channels. Units shall complete data validation and squadron review before submission. Acknowledge receipt of this message in ANCHOR.

Heading: Point of Contact
Body: COMSUBLANT N3 Readiness Division, DSN 312-555-0101, n3readiness@example.mil

Heading: Enclosures
Body: Deployment Readiness Reporting Template (Excel)\nReporting Procedures Guide\nFrequently Asked Questions
